# laravelforge_server_network_info (Data Source)

Reads the network membership of a Laravel Forge server (singleton per server): the set of servers that share this server's private network. Read-only companion to the `laravelforge_server_network` resource.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `organization` (String) Organization slug.
- `server_id` (Number) ID of the server whose network membership is read.

### Read-Only

- `server_count` (Number) Number of servers in this server's network.
- `servers` (Set of Number) Numeric IDs of the servers in this server's network.
